name: Ocean & Lighthouse

image.prompt: Painterly illustration in a 70/30 style blend: primarily (70%) the atmospheric, painterly style of the animated series Scavengers Reign — muted naturalistic palette, organic textures, soft volumetric haze and lighting, subtle bioluminescent color accents — blended with (30%) the warm, soft style of Studio Ghibli background art. Gentle brushwork, soft diffused light, calm and cozy mood, no harsh shadows. No text, no logos, no watermark. Tuesday, a 3-year-old girl with a short chestnut-blonde bob haircut (a darker, warm honey-brown blonde) with a soft fringe, rosy cheeks and a small button nose. She looks clearly three, not a baby: a slightly slimmer face that has lost most of its baby chubbiness, longer legs and a taller, steadier standing posture, proportions of a preschooler rather than an infant. She wears a simple cream sweater and stands on a grassy coastal headland, seen from slightly behind at three-quarter view, looking out at the ocean. Middle-right background: a white lighthouse with a red-roofed lamp room on the point, its window glowing warm gold, a soft beam of light in the air. Dusk blue-hour sky, deep indigo and soft lavender clouds, calm rolling waves below the cliff catching the last light. A tiny hidden easter egg, easy to miss: far out in the waves, a very small mermaid rests stomach-down on a rock with her back arched up. She has a green tail, red hair and a purple clam shell bikini top, catching the last light. Tuesday in the lower third, generous sky above. Horizontal 16:9 landscape composition.

video.prompt: The lighthouse beam sweeps smoothly and steadily across the sky, one full sweep that ends where it began. Ocean waves roll gently and rhythmically below the cliff in a steady swell. Clouds drift almost imperceptibly. Tuesday stands still; only a light sway of her hair in the sea breeze. Calm, ambient dusk. Locked-off static camera: no camera movement, no zoom, no pan. Slow, continuous, cyclical, steady-state motion only — nothing that builds, changes pose, or tells a story. Lighting and color held constant throughout. The final frame returns exactly to the starting image so the clip loops seamlessly. No text, no captions, no audio.
video.negative_prompt: camera movement, zoom, pan, cuts, scene change, lighting change, new characters, text, subtitles, morphing faces, extra limbs
video.audio_note: Veo 3.1 always generates audio; build_loop.py discards it

licensing: Ariel (Disney) is a copyrighted character, included as a small easter egg. Private, non-commercial use on a device in Tuesday's room only. Rendered files must never be committed, published or shared.

water_pass.mode: image_to_video, first frame only (free-running, no last-frame pin)
water_pass.use: Only the open-water region is used, as the moving sea layer under a static sky/land/Tuesday plate (see media/tools/ocean_compose.py). Looped with a 2 s crossfade.
water_pass.prompt: The ocean waves roll in continuously and rhythmically from the horizon toward the rocky shore at a constant, steady pace for the entire clip; each wave swells, breaks into soft white foam, and washes back, followed immediately by the next. The sea never calms, slows or stops. Locked-off static camera: no camera movement, no zoom, no pan. Everything except the water stays completely still: the sky, clouds, lighthouse, cliffs, grass and the girl do not move. Lighting and color held constant throughout. Painterly style unchanged. No text, no captions, no audio.
